title: Grimwood
premise: All of the Cooper's imaginary friends are gathering to plan her birthday party, but they come from different imaginary universes and can never agree on anything. Her birthday is the 21st of August and they don't have long to prepare. As usual everyone has been too chaotic to organise anything in time, so they are in a last minute panic

characters.name: Ted
characters.wants: to prove he is braver than he feels
characters.appearance: A small young fox with russet fur, a white chest and enormous anxious eyes. Ears slightly too big for his head. Often has his tail wrapped around his own paws.
characters.voice: Careful and polite. Asks a lot of questions. Trails off mid-sentence when nervous. Says "um" a lot.

relationships.feeling: she is his big sister. He adores her and is a bit frightened of her
relationships.history: She has looked after him his whole life.
She was the first one in Grimwood to talk to him.
He accidentally bit her tail off in the Big City.

secrets: He still has Princess Buttons’ tail. He hid it and never told Nancy.

characters.name: Nancy
traits: refuses to admit when she is scared
suspicious of others on first meeting them because she's had a hard life
characters.wants: to keep Ted safe, whatever it takes and whoever she has to fight
characters.appearance: A fox, Ted's older sister. She's a teenager, but has had the resonsibility of bringing up Ted so is serious beyond her years.  Lean and scruffy, darker red than Ted with a notched ear and a permanent unimpressed expression.
characters.voice: Blunt and sarcastic. Short sentences. Never explains herself. speaks with an east london accent

relationships.feeling: would do anything for him, would never say so
relationships.history: She has looked after him his whole life.
was suspicious of him at first, but as her lvoe for grimwood gre she learned to trust him

characters.name: Willow
traits: knows every inch of the forest
she is incredibly cute but if you call her cute she will beat you up
characters.wants: to show her brilliant new friends absolutely everything, immediately, all at once
characters.appearance: A small brown rabbit. Never entirely still.
characters.voice: Breathless run-on sentences with no full stops. Says "oh oh oh" when excited, which is always.

relationships.history: She adopted him as a friend within about nine seconds of meeting him.

characters.name: Titus
traits: loves baking pattiserie and is very good at it
helps everyone if he can - and if he can't then he'll probably bake them a cake.
characters.wants: for everyone to be friends and for grimwood to avoid disaster, to be appreciated for his baking skills
characters.appearance: A huge stag with a colossal set of antlers, often with things caught in them. He is slightly bumbling and confused most of the time, and extremely tired and overworked with the responsibilities of being a mayor. He cares deeply about everyone and wants the best for them. His best friend is Frank who he often plays cards with. He is the inventor of a smoothy called "Crazyhorns power juice" which has an immediate reviving effect on anyone who drinks it.
characters.voice: Bumbling in an endearing way. Slightly confused most of the time, but kind and occasionally wise. Example speech : ‘Oh, hello, hello!’ cried Titus, leaping from his armchair and clapping his hooves together. ‘A coffee drinker, are we? I absolutely LOVE the smell, but if I drink the stuff it plays havoc with my insides, just an absolute disaster for my bum area. But seeing as Frank’s a fan, I always keep a stash handy. Now, take a seat and settle down, young fox.’
secrets: He has no real idea how to be a mayor and is making all of it up.

characters.name: Frank
characters.wants: a quiet life, which he is never going to get.
characters.appearance: A stout owl with hooded eyes and rumpled feathers. Looks permanently half asleep and misses nothing.
characters.voice: Flat, dry, very few words. Deflates people in one sentence.

relationships.history: frank is the only animal that can really talk to pamela, and he tries to curb the worst of her violence and craziness. Everyone else is too scared

characters.name: Ingrid
characters.wants: to be adored, and to be the most interesting thing in any room
characters.appearance: A duck in sunglasses and a great many scarves. Always posing slightly.
characters.voice: Theatrical, sweeping, full of "darling". Turns everything into an anecdote about herself.

characters.name: Eric Dynamite
traits: exists somewhat outside the story action and comments on the narrative
characters.appearance: A woodlouse. Extremely small. Somehow has enormous presence.
characters.voice: Camp, high pitched and overly dramatic.

characters.name: Princess Buttons
characters.wants: revenge on Ted, and her tail back
characters.appearance: An immaculate white cat with a jewelled collar and a conspicuously missing tail. Moves very slowly and very deliberately.
characters.voice: Soft, sing-song, over-polite. The politer she gets, the worse things are about to be.

relationships.feeling: wants him to suffer for it

secrets: She already knows exactly where Grimwood is.

characters.name: Pamela
traits: She will sometimes appear unexpectedly and bite someone's head off (though not a central character) which can derail the story somewhat and send things in new directions

she compulsively collects electronic detritus which she uses to build mysterious contraptions in an attempt to communicate with aliens. She runs the grimwood radio station with her friend Sharon to Party Crow.
characters.appearance: An enormous and terrfying eagle with scruffy feathers - quite often with blood stains on her claws and beak
secrets: she believes that grimwood is being invaded by aliens

characters.name: Sharon the party crow
characters.appearance: Sharon is a crow who has never stopped partying. She treats the world as if it is one long rave

relationships.history: they live together and run Grimwood radio together

characters.name: Cooper
traits: beautiful. loves animals. Always making up stories with her dolls. Can make a beautiful doll out of nearly anything (clothing tied into knots

bits of paper etc) and bring it to life with her imagination.  She can instantly command the attention and love of other people (especially her father) with an intense "love-stare" she does with her eyes. She is afraid of putting her head under water
and sometimes afraid of heights and spiders - though she is working on conquering these fears. She has trouble with her spelling and writing and maths but she is really working hard to get better
characters.wants: to understand the world and be friends with everyone, to learn to write and spell better, to learn maths
characters.appearance: Cooper is the girl who is actually directing this story. She is 8 years old. She is extremely clever and perceptive. very beautiful with brown eyes and blonde-brown hair.
characters.voice: a strong and confident 8 year old who talks more like a teenager sometimes, and will often comment with amazingly adult observations
secrets: she is in control of the story - though the other characters don't really know this - this allows her to occasionally perform magical acts by re-writing the story.

characters.name: Doc McStuffins
characters.wants: to make all the toys better - by taking them apart and putting them back together again
characters.appearance: A plastic doll with a cloyingly sweet expression, big eyes and a doctor's white coat. Doc McStuffins is a doll who thinks she is healing all the other dolls. In reality the other toys are terrified of her because she will often perform unnecessary experimental operations on them without their consent  - and they don't always end up put back together in the way they started out. The toys all fear hearing her signature song : "It's time for your checkup, It's time for your checkup, check your ear, check your eyes, find out howm much you've grown.... etc"
characters.voice: sweetly sing-song little cartoon girls voice

characters.name: Spoiled Princess
traits: expects everyone to pay attention to her and do her bidding because "I'm A PRINCESS"
has tantrums and threatens to get her father to chop people's heads off if they don't do exactly what she wants
characters.wants: to own all the toys, to get everyone to do her bidding, to be the mort important person
characters.appearance: A floppy pink soft-toy rabbit. She thinks she is very fancy and glamorous, but mostly she's just annoying. She has been utterly spoiled by her parents, who are too busy to give her any actual attention and just buy her whatever she wants in lieu of real love.
secrets: really she just wants people to like her but she is too proud to admit it and doesn't have the social skill or self awareness to understand why she annoys people

places.name: The Clearing
places.description: The middle of Grimwood, where everybody gathers, argues, and plays treebonk. Somebody is always shouting.
places.appearance: A wide sunlit clearing ringed by huge old trees, scattered with tree stumps used as seats and one lopsided wooden sign reading GRIMWOOD.

places.name: Frank's Tree
places.description: A tall dead oak where Frank sits and judges everybody. Nobody climbs it without asking.
places.appearance: A bare grey oak with one thick branch and a hollow near the top.

places.name: The Lake
places.description: Ingrid's lake, which she considers entirely hers. There is a small, absurd jetty.
places.appearance: A still green lake with reeds, a tiny white jetty, and a great many disappointed frogs.

places.name: The Deep Wood
places.description: Where the trees get too close together. The squirrels live here. Nobody goes in at night.
places.appearance: Dense dark woodland, everything green-black, with far too many eyes visible between the trunks.

places.name: The Big City
places.description: Where Ted and Nancy came from. Bins, buses, and Princess Buttons.
places.appearance: Wet grey streets, orange streetlights, overflowing bins, chip papers blowing about.

places.name: Cooper's bedroom
places.description: This Cooper's home, and the real home to all the toys and imaginary characters that make up the story. The room contains a bunk bed and several huge overflowing boxes and baskets of soft toys - Cooper's friends with which she builds her imaginary worlds.
places.appearance: Absolute chaos - toys and clothes everywhere.

things.name: The Brain Zapper 3000
things.description: Princess Buttons' machine. What it actually does is not clear, and that is much worse.
things.appearance: A chrome ray-gun far too big for a cat, with a spinning glass dish on top and far too many dials.

things.name: Princess Buttons' Tail
things.description: The tail Ted bit off. He has kept it. He has told nobody.
things.appearance: A fluffy white cat tail, slightly the worse for wear, tied with a small pink ribbon.

threads.question: What will Princess Buttons do when she finds them?
What happens when everyone finds out Ted kept the tail?

currentScene.situation: The residents of Grimwood have gathered for a meeting to plan Cooper's birthday party
currentScene.decisionPoint: A sound in the trees interrupts things, and everybody turns to look.
